result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the 90-day LOC instead of the 180-day figure.

The bug was in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java`, line 120. The block formatted `loc180Days` while its count and percentage used the 90-day values. I changed that one reference to `loc90Days`. The count, percentage, and the other four periods are unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o -pl reports test -Dtest='*Landscape*'`, which completed with no output, so the build and the landscape tests passed. No test covers this block specifically, so the fix is checked by reading the code rather than by a test. Nothing was committed.
